title: Two Captures, One Check
setup: White's queen on b6 is standing loose, and the rook on c1 is attacking your queen. Ask the three questions before you take anything.
hint: White threatens a check on the eighth rank that your king cannot escape. One of your captures comes with check, and a check cannot be ignored.
explanation:
## The Idea

Question one: White is threatening to take your queen, and to check on the eighth rank, where your king has no square to run to.

Question two finds two captures. {{Qxb6}} wins a queen, and question three throws it away: the rook checks on c8, and mate follows.

{{Qxc1+}} wins a rook with check, from a square nothing attacks. White has to answer the check, and you are a rook and a knight ahead, with time to deal with the threat.
